      • performProcedureSetup

        public Procedure performProcedureSetup(Long procedureTypeId,
                              Session session,
                              String testNumber,
                              boolean operational,
                              ProcedureOutput procedureOutput)
                                throws Exception
        Initial procedure setup tasks: load up all default procedure configurations depending on procedure type. This method is called when a procedure type to run is first selected and afterwards the user has an opportunity to change the default values.
        Parameters:
        procedureTypeId - the type of the procedure being set up
        session - the current night session
        testNumber - the test number potentially carried over from previous procedure
        procedureOutput - the procedure output object to assign
        Returns:
        the procedure, now set up with default configurations
        Throws:
        Exception

      • setupPupilRegIntTime

        public void setupPupilRegIntTime(Procedure procedure)
        Sets up the integration time procedure configuration element for Pupil Registration The mask type is used to determine the integration time. Called initially and when mask type is changed by user
        Parameters:
        procedure - the procedure being set up

      • setupCreateRefMapDefaults

        public void setupCreateRefMapDefaults(Procedure procedure,
                             Long instrumentId,
                             Long pupilMaskTypeId,
                             Long filterTypeId,
                             Long ccdTypeId)
        Sets up default values for the create reference beam map procedure This method is called on procedure setup and when the user changes the pupil mask or filter
        Parameters:
        procedure - the procedure being set up
        instrumentId - PCS1 or PCS2
        pupilMaskTypeId - the pupil mask type currently selected
        filterTypeId - the filter type currently selected
